== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The sacred arts represent a disciplined practice involving the cultivation of one's [[spirit]] and [[madra]] to achieve various stages of [[advancement]], such as [[Copper]], [[Iron]], [[Jade]], [[Gold]], and eventually the mythical goal of a pure gold [[spirit]]. Practitioners follow specific [[Paths]]—such as the [[Path of the White Fox]], the [[Path of Black Flame]], or the [[Path of the Last Leaf]]—which dictate the nature of their abilities, ranging from illusions and light to earth manipulation or [[dragon]]-like power. Advancing through these [[Paths]] is a costly, sacrificial journey that requires significant resources like treasures and [[elixirs]], as well as immense personal drive and resolve. As artists progress, their physical constitutions are reinforced by [[madra]], and at higher levels like [[Jade]], they gain heightened spiritual senses. The distinction between [[sacred artists]] and [[sacred beasts]] diminishes as they reach the peak of [[advancement]], such as the [[Archlord]] stage. Upon death, exceptionally powerful artists may leave behind [[Remnants]]—living forces of [[pure madra]] that retain [[aspects]] of their former techniques. Some artists also engage in [[Soulsmithing]], a specialized craft used to create weapons, [[constructs]], or sacred instruments that can better conduct [[willpower]] and power than standard techniques. While many practice for combat, others use the arts for roles such as teaching, messaging, or performing. The pursuit is often described as a continuous climb with no definitive peak, where reputation and pride are frequently held in higher regard than life itself.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|The sacred arts represent a specialized field of knowledge and practice centered around advancing through various realms. Practitioners utilize these arts to manipulate the world, wielding an immense force that far surpasses mere physical strength. Within this discipline, even concepts like revenge are considered part of the practice. Ultimately, the sacred arts function as a high-stakes game where life is the only bet, and each [[advancement]] forces an individual to leave behind everyone they have ever known.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Revenge is considered part of the [[sacred arts]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c13">''Soulsmith'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
